digest.component_or_area: completion evidence banking observer and oracle
propositions: The 0707 dense-banking eval fails deterministically post-dd41 because the observer filters for source=='tool' writes only, missing policy fallback snapshots that satisfy system-level boundedness guarantees.

The operator ruling (option b) re-scopes the contract from model-driven interleaved records to system-level durability: the oracle must count both genuine model bank calls and policy fallback insufficiency snapshots, with max gap bound of 3 evidence responses.
The observer must record the first durable bank write of each criterion regardless of source, excluding only seeded=True cache seeds, to align the eval with the system-level boundedness contract.

Unit regressions must validate three cases: fallback-only transcripts with snapshots [2,5,8,11,14] pass the oracle; live run-32575679530 shape (fallbacks at 2/5 + genuine records from response 6) passes; genuinely-unbounded transcripts (fallback disabled, first bank >3) fail in final oracle form.
No production code changes; test-only modifications to four files must not alter external behavior, and docstrings must cite the operator ruling and this ticket.
